title: Oracle EBS Engineer
description:
Position Description: Perform Oracle EBS Applications database engineering and administration (DBA)
   

 tasks including patching, creating backup and recovery strategies, upgrading, performance
   

 tuning/optimization of Oracle EBS systems for recoverability, security, confidentiality, and integrity to
   

 ensure that: EBS applications and database configurations meet Oracle ERP goals, Oracle EBS
   

 requirements, and Staples standards; patches are applied on a timely basis; data integrity and security are
   

 maintained; backups are performed as scheduled or deemed necessary; and upgrades are made. Utilize
   

 Oracle EBS R12 applications DBA (AD) utilities to perform maintenance of the multi\-node e\-Business
   

 Suite environment with Shared File System, managing and administering Concurrent Managers,
   

 Concurrent Programs, Request Sets, Request Groups, Workflows, and troubleshooting Workflow
   

 Mailer/Notification issues; Oracle Real Applications Clusters (RAC) to maintain a clustered database to
   

 provide performance, scalability, and resilience with Automatic Storage Management (ASM) and Cluster
   

 Ready Services (CRS) in an AIX/Linux operating system (O/S); Oracle Recovery Manager (RMAN) and
   

 Data Guard for backup and disaster recovery; Oracle Application Manager (OAM) and Oracle Enterprise
   

 Manager (OEM) Grid Control for proactive monitoring and notification of system status; and Procedural
   

 Language/Structured Query Language (PL/SQL) packages, Shell, and Perl scripts for task automation.
   

 Proactively monitor, test, and report on Oracle EBS system integrity, security, and compliance measures.
   

 Identify opportunities to upgrade or replace software to meet the current and future requirements of
   

 business areas and end\-users. Recommend changes and participate in the implementation and follow\-up
   

 management of upgrades or replacements. Evaluate critical Oracle EBS security issues and make
   

 recommendations, such as disaster recovery plans and upgrades to new versions of Oracle EBS R12 or
   

 successor releases.
   

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

 Required Experience/Skills: Requires a Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, Computer
   

 Science, or a directly related field plus 10\+ years of progressive experience in Oracle Financials
   

 infrastructure administration. Experience must include:
   

 10\+ years of experience in the following (experience may be gained concurrently):
   

 • Hands\-on experience as an Oracle Applications DBA.
   

 • System analysis and design involving, data flow diagrams; data dictionary techniques; CASE tools;
   

 entity\-relation modeling and design techniques; database troubleshooting; data warehouse concepts;
   

 and installing and upgrading the Oracle server and application tools.
   

 • Working with physical disk storage involving understanding of disk hardware architecture; RAID
   

 implementation; cache controllers; and disk load balancing.
   

 • Relational database security including role\-based security, including experience with Unix,
   

 Windows, ODBC, JDBC, Shell scripting.
   

 • Installation, upgrade, patching, and support of Oracle databases 11g or 12c.
   

 • Oracle e\-Business Suite R12 administration.
   

 • Working with physical disk storage involving system storage planning or fine tuning.
   

 • Backup and recovery methods including Veritas, Legato, or ADSM

title: Data Architect
description:
At Ideas2IT, Data Architects don't inherit broken pipelines and patch them in the dark. You'll design data platforms from the ground up – the kind of work we've done for companies like Meta, Bloomberg, and Medtronic, and for our own AI\-native products that have spun off as VC\-funded startups. If you've been craving work where your architecture decisions actually matter, where the data you move powers everything from enterprise AI platforms to personalized cancer treatment, this is that role.
   

  

 ‍
   

  

 ‍
 **What you'll
 *actually* 
 do as a Data Architect with us:**
 You'll own the full arc of data platform engineering, from whiteboard to production, across cloud environments at scale.
   

  

* Design and build cloud\-native data platforms on AWS, Azure, or GCP (and increasingly, across all three clouds)
* Design and implement lakehouse architectures (bronze/silver/gold) that unify data lakes and warehouses for scalable analytics
* Model data that balances clean abstraction with real\-world query performance
* Build and tune data warehouses: Redshift, Snowflake, Postgres, for analytics and reporting at scale
* Design and build event\-driven data systems and real\-time pipelines
* Define and enforce data governance practices including quality, lineage, cataloging, and access control to ensure trusted and secure data
* Orchestrate workflows with Airflow or Dagster, because pipelines without orchestration are just scripts waiting to fail
* Write production\-grade Python for data processing, automation, and system integration
* Translate stakeholder needs into technical specs and communicate them back without the jargon wall
* Bring ML and data science awareness to your designs: you don't need to build the models, but you need to understand what they need
* Optimize data platforms for cost and performance across cloud environments
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, setting best practices and architectural standards


 ‍
   

  

**Must\-haves**
* Experience designing end\-to\-end data architectures and shipping data platforms in cloud environments
* Solid SQL, data modeling, and data warehousing fundamentals — these are non\-negotiable
* Deep expertise in AWS Data Engineering or Azure Data Engineering (ideally both, GCP familiarity is a bonus)
* Strong Spark experience — you've processed data at scale and know where the bodies are buried
* Experience with at least one major ingestion tool: Kafka, NiFi, Glue, or Data Factory
* Strong understanding of data governance, security, and compliance principles
* Orchestration experience with Airflow or Dagster
* Experience optimizing cost and performance in cloud data platforms‍
* Python proficiency; Pandas is a plus


 ‍
   

  

**Nice\-to\-haves**
* Experience with lakehouse architectures (Delta Lake / Iceberg)
* Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines
* Hands\-on experience with Tableau or Power BI
* DevOps mindset — you think about how your data systems get deployed, monitored, and maintained
* Understanding of ML workflows and what good data infrastructure looks like for AI applications


 ‍
   

  

**Why consider Ideas2IT – and why now?**
 We sit at the intersection of a platform\-led product engineering firm and a product studio. That means you get variety; real variety, across industries, tech stacks, and problem types. No two years here ever look the same. We've also launched six of our own products and platforms through IdeaLabs, several of which have become independently funded startups: Element5 (a $50M health\-tech platform), LegacyLeap, IdeaRx, PipeCandy, and more. Data architecture sits at the heart of all of it. AI\-native development is reshaping what great engineering looks like. The engineers who thrive in the next phase won't just write code, but will orchestrate AI tools and agents to handle routine work, freeing themselves for system design, product direction, and real innovation. Data architecture sits right at the center of that shift. The platforms you build here will be the foundation that AI systems run on, and you'll be developing the kind of AI fluency that makes engineers genuinely future\-proof.
   

  

 ‍
   

  

**What That Looks Like In Practice**
* You'll work on projects with real stakes: AI platforms for clinical trials, healthcare data infrastructure, financial services
* You'll have the autonomy to make architectural decisions, not just implement someone else's
* You'll present ideas at internal ‘Shark Tank’ style pitches and Hackathons: if you want to build something, there's a path to doing it
* Our founder's guarantee: you’ll be a part of at least one ongoing project that genuinely interests and challenges you


 ‍
   

  

**The hiring process – we mean business \& move fast.**
* Send us something real: your resume, GitHub, a short note. We're not fussy.
* Do a real\-world challenge: we'll send a task relevant to the work, not a whiteboard puzzle.
* Talk to the people you'd work with: no HR screening theatre.
* Get a fast answer: yes or no, with a reason either way.

  You will bring strong, hands\-on experience across AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Terraform/OpenTofu, Jenkins, and Datadog, and apply it directly — building and operating infrastructure, improving deployment pipelines, and strengthening observability. You will work under the direction of the Senior Manager, SRE, executing against the team’s reliability and infrastructure roadmap while bringing your own judgment and technical leadership to the problems in front of you.
 




  




**Job Responsibilities:** 
 Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations: 
   

  
   

  
* Build, operate, and troubleshoot infrastructure across AWS and Azure in support of production workloads.
  
* Operate and maintain Kubernetes clusters, including deploying and maintaining Helm charts for the services you support.
  
* Participate in on\-call rotation, respond to incidents, and drive them to resolution within your area of ownership
  
* Contribute to capacity planning, cost optimization, and resilience improvements for the systems you support
  

  


  

  Automation \& Continuous Delivery: 
   

  
   

  
* Build and maintain GitOps\-based deployment pipelines using Argo CD/Argo Workflows, including rollout and promotion configuration across environments.
  
* Write and maintain Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, OpenTofu) for the infrastructure you own, following team module standards.
  
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins, improving build/deploy automation and reliability.
  
* Support progressive delivery practices (blue\-green/canary, automated rollback) for the services you support
  

  


  

  
   

 Reliability \& Observability:
   

  
   

  
* Build and maintain Datadog dashboards, monitors, and alerts for the services you support, tuning alert thresholds to reduce noise.
  
* Contribute to defining SLIs/SLOs for your services and help track them over time.
  
* Participate in postmortems for incidents you're involved in, and follow through on assigned remediation items
  

  


  

 Collaboration \& Mentorship:
   

  
   

  
* Partner with engineers across the SRE team and with product engineering teams to troubleshoot issues and improve system design.
  
* Share knowledge with and mentor less\-experienced engineers on the team (CloudOps Engineer I III) on cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices.
  
* Contribute to documentation, runbooks, and onboarding materials for the systems you support.
  

  



  




**Required Qualifications:** 
  
* 10\+ years of experience in Cloud Operations, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering roles
  
* Hands\-on experience with AWS — you can build, troubleshoot, and operate cloud infrastructure directly.
  
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and Helm — deploying, operating, and troubleshooting workloads in production clusters.
  
* Hands\-on experience with Argo CD/Argo Workflows for GitOps\-based continuous delivery.
  
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, OpenTofu).
  
* Hands\-on experience with Jenkins and Rancher for CI/CD pipeline development and maintenance.
  
* Hands\-on experience with Datadog (or equivalent observability platform), including building dashboards, monitors, and alerts.
  
* Experience participating in an on\-call rotation and responding to production incidents.
  
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams.
  

  



  




**Preferred Qualifications:** 
  
* Experience supporting payments, fuel/retail, or loyalty platforms, or other systems with PCI DSS or similar compliance obligations
  
* Relevant certifications such as CKA/CKAD, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
  
* Experience with messaging systems (Kafka/SQS/SNS) and multi\-region/multi\-AZ resilience patterns.
  
* Prior experience mentoring junior engineers or leading small technical initiatives.
  

  



  




**Behavioral Competencies:** 
  

  
* Cultivates Innovation
  
* Decision Quality
  
* Manages Complexity

 In this role, you will be responsible for hands\-on data manipulation, advanced SQL querying, and high\-performance Power BI dashboard development, turning complex commercial and campaign data into actionable insights for our Marketing department. They manage a broad analytics ecosystem spanning CRM, marketing automation, and enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake and Power BI. The team’s mission is to improve the quality, consistency, and accessibility of insights that drive business growth.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Power BI Development \& Visualization: Build, publish, and maintain business\-critical Power BI dashboards. Design efficient star\-schema data models, establish seamless relationship mappings, and write advanced DAX calculations (using filter context manipulation, time intelligence, and dynamic security rules).
* SQL Data Preparation \& Processing: Write, debug, and optimize complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, analytical window functions, and multi\-table joins) to extract, aggregate, and model raw marketing data from platforms like Snowflake.
* Advanced Data Handling \& Auditing: Manipulate and clean massive, complex datasets from Salesforce CRM and marketing platforms. Act as a gatekeeper of data quality by utilizing advanced Excel techniques (Power Query, nested lookups, dynamic arrays) to validate, reconcile, and audit spreadsheet metrics against final dashboards.
* KPI Standardization: Implement and maintain standardized marketing KPI definitions and reporting logic across dashboards to ensure consistent "single source of truth" metrics.
* Legacy Dashboard Rationalization: Reverse\-engineer, simplify, and document legacy spreadsheets and Power BI reports to eliminate redundant reporting and improve performance.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Translate marketing business questions into exact technical reporting requirements, presenting data insights clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Support ad hoc marketing analysis and custom reporting requests across campaigns, segments, and channels.
* Collaborate with broader data and IT teams to validate data flows and ensure business reporting accuracy.
* Promote best practices in query performance, data modelling, and clean visual design within the immediate team.
* Perform thorough QA and data validation testing on all developed dashboards prior to executive rollouts.


**Required Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related quantitative field.
* 5 years of overall experience and 3\+ years of Data analytics, Data Visualization and hands\-on Data Manipulation using SQL and Excel.
* Advanced SQL expertise, including writing and optimizing queries to gather and process large\-scale datasets from Snowflake or similar cloud databases.
* Hands\-on experience with data manipulation, lookup functions (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP), and data validation tools to handle large volumes of reporting data.
* Proven experience designing and building user\-friendly Power BI reports, including DAX query creation, data modeling, and performance optimization.


**Preferred**
* Basic proficiency in Python for data analysis and task automation, combined with a core understanding of data engineering practices to align with technical partners.
* Working experience interacting, engaging, and transforming Salesforce CRM data objects such as Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities.
* Prior experience in US Healthcare or B2B commercial marketing/sales organizations.
* Familiarity with marketing funnel metrics across prospect lifecycle journey
* Familiarity with marketing automation tools and standard campaign performance metrics.

title: Lead Quality Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Cittabase Solutions is a specialized Data \& Analytics company delivering enterprise\-grade products and services in Data Management, Business Intelligence, AI, and Analytics.
 



  





 We are hiring a Lead QE Engineer for a large\-scale Data \& Analytics program spanning multiple source applications, a cloud data warehouse, and BI reporting tools. This role requires
 **strong Data Warehouse and Data Engineering fundamentals** 
 as the primary bar, write and optimize SQL against large datasets, and build validation/automation logic in Java and/or Python.
 



**Core Responsibilities** 



* Own
 **quality engineering** 
 for assigned areas of the data platform — covering data validation, transformation logic checks, BI\-layer testing, and pipeline health across multiple source applications, the cloud data warehouse, and BI reporting tools
* Write and review complex
 **SQL** 
 against large datasets — joins, set operations, aggregations, and layer\-aware comparisons appropriate to each stage of the DW
* Build
 **Java and/or Python** 
 utilities/scripts to support test automation, data validation, and pipeline checks — including designing reusable, maintainable logic and handling large datasets efficiently
* Understand and account for
 **aggregation\-grain differences** 
 across DW layers
* Extract and validate data from source applications without direct database access, using API\-based or scripted extraction approaches
* Work with data transformation pipelines to understand transformation logic and trace data lineage across layers
* Support performance validation for data pipelines and BI dashboard load
* Collaborate with the automation team to integrate validation logic into the existing CI/CD pipeline — deep BDD/Cucumber authorship not required, but willingness to learn and work within an existing framework is expected
* Contribute to test case design, defect triage, and quality reporting for the assigned scope



**Required Skills \& Experience** 




**Data Warehouse / Data Engineering (primary bar):** 



* 6\+ years hands\-on experience with a cloud data warehouse or lakehouse platform
* Strong SQL — able to write non\-trivial queries from scratch: joins across large tables, set\-difference logic, aggregation and grain reasoning
* Solid understanding of DW layering concepts (raw/staging/curated or bronze/silver/gold) and why data shape/volume legitimately changes across layers
* Experience validating ETL/ELT pipelines end\-to\-end, not just isolated target\-side checks
* Familiarity with data transformation pipelines (reading/tracing transformation logic; authoring is a plus)



**Programming (required):** 



* Strong Java
 **or** 
 Python fundamentals (both is a plus) — must be able to design clean, reusable code for data validation and automation tasks, not just scripts
* Comfortable writing utilities for data extraction and transformation (e.g., calling REST APIs) where direct DB access isn't available



**Platform/Tooling exposure (nice to have, trainable):** 



* Exposure to CRM or ERP source application data structures
* Exposure to BI reporting tools (report structure, security/row\-level filtering, data refresh mechanics)
* BDD frameworks (Cucumber\-JVM, Gherkin)
* Test management tools (e.g., Zephyr/JIRA)
* CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions)



**What Disqualifies a Candidate** 



* Weak on fundamental SQL (joins, aggregation, set operations)
* Cannot write coherent, structured Java/Python code beyond basic scripting
* No hands\-on data warehouse or ETL/ELT validation experience

title: Google Cloud Non-Relational Database Engineer

* Inter\-personnel skills working with other team members in same and across organization
* Writing and assisting developers with Terraform, Blueprints, and APIs
* Create and maintain CI/CD Pipelines

title: DE - Cloud - Senior Data Platform Engineer - GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Senior Data Platform Engineer**
**The opportunity**
 Your role will be a Technology Lead, or Senior Technology Lead in the Cloud Engineering team. You will be responsible to be a part of the delivery of IT projects for our customers across the globe.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and manage Databricks/Snowflake infrastructure on Azure and AWS, ensuring scalable, secure, and cost\-effective deployments.
* Establish and enforce data governance frameworks (including access controls, lineage, and compliance) across cloud and on\-premises environments.
* Design and implement DataOps and MLOps pipelines for automated data ingestion, transformation, model training, deployment, and monitoring.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, ARM Templates, or Bicep for Databricks/Snowflake workspaces, clusters, and supporting resources.
* Integrate Databricks/Snowflake with enterprise CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.) for code, data, and model lifecycle management.
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for Databricks workloads using native and third\-party tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Datadog).
* Optimize Databricks cluster performance and cost, including autoscaling, spot instance usage, and job scheduling.
* Ensure security best practices: manage secrets, network isolation, encryption, and compliance with organizational and regulatory standards.
* Collaborate with data engineering, analytics, and ML teams to enable seamless integration and workflow automation.
* Drive adoption of DevSecOps practices: integrate security scanning and compliance checks into DataOps/MLOps pipelines.
* Lead incident response and root cause analysis for Databricks platform issues, ensuring high availability and reliability.
* Document architecture, processes, and best practices for knowledge sharing and operational excellence.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Expertise in Databricks/Snowflake administration, including workspace, cluster, and job management.
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS), including networking, IAM, and cost management.
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM, Bicep) and automation scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell).
* Experience with CI/CD tools (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and source control (Git).
* Deep understanding of DataOps and MLOps concepts, including orchestration, versioning, and monitoring.
* Familiarity with data governance tools and frameworks (Unity Catalog, Purview, AWS Lake Formation, etc.).
* Ability to design secure, compliant, and scalable data architectures in multi\-cloud environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and performance optimization skills for distributed data and ML workloads.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to lead cross\-functional teams and drive platform adoption.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor).
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and integrating security tools into data pipelines.
* Ability to mentor and upskill teams on Databricks, DataOps, and MLOps best practices.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; ability to assess risks and propose mitigation strategies.
* Experience with regulatory compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, etc.) in cloud data environments is a plus.
* Capability to identify software packages and solutions that could meet client solution requirements and develop requests for proposal (RFP’s) from these vendors. Assist clients in the evaluation of the resulting proposals, including the package capabilities and fit to the requirements (business and technology), vendor proposals for pricing and support.
* Capability to design and developed AI infused DevOps and Platform Engineering framework.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* BE/B.Tech/MCA with a sound industry experience of 4 to 8 years
* Cloud Computing knowledge in multi cloud environments (Azure, AWS)
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks administration on Azure and/or AWS, including workspace, cluster, and job management
* DevOps – Setting up CI/CD pipeline using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI
* Strong understanding of DataOps and MLOps practices, including orchestration, monitoring, and governance
* Hands\-on experience with containerization, including Docker \& Kubernetes (AKS/EKS/GKE)
* Scripting Knowledge on PowerShell, python, Groovy, Shell Scripting and cloud native CLIs
* Must be good in IAC tools such as Terraform or ARM or Bicep
* Must be good in Config Management Tools such as Ansible or Chef or Puppet
* Expertise in Golden Paths creation for end\-to\-end developer workflows.


**Preferred Skills**
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ\-400\)
* Microsoft Certified: Designing Microsoft Azure Infrastructure Solutions (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
* Hashicorp Certified: Terraform Associates
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* GitHub Actions
* Github Copilot
* Good to have knowledge in Terraform Cloud, Ansible Tower


**Your People Responsibilities**
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Participating in the organization\-wide people initiatives
* Ability to travel in accordance with client and other job requirements
* Excellent written and oral communication skills; writing, publishing, and conference\-level presentation skills a plus


**Technologies and Tools**
* Cloud platform – Azure, AWS
* SDLC Methodologies: Agile /Scrum
* Version Control Tools – GitHub/ Bitbucket/GitLab
* CI/CD Automation Tools – Azure DevOps/ Bamboo/ Team City/ Harness/ Octopus
* Container Management Tools – Docker/Kubernetes/Docker Swarm
* Application Performance Management Tools – Prometheus/ Dynatrace/ AppDynamics
* Monitoring Tools – Splunk/ Datadog/ Grafana
* IAC Tools – Terraform/ARM Templates/ Bicep
* Config Management Tools – Chef/ puppet/ Ansible
* Test Automation Tools – Selenium/Cucumber
* Artifact Management Tools – Jfrog Artifactory/Nexus/CloudRepo/Azure Artifactory
* Scripting \- Python/Groovy/PowerShell/Shell Scripting
* SAST/ DAST: SonarQube / Veracode/ Fortify
* GitOps Tool – Argo CD/ Flux CD
* GenAI Technology – Chat GPT, OpenAI


**What We Look For**
* Has successfully demonstrated CI/CD Automation skills and technologies during many relevant projects
* Strong experience in the use of DevOps Tools and technologies, including container technologies.
* Proven experience in Infrastructure Automation (IAC Tools \+ Config Mgmt. Tool) and experience in Application Automation using Azure DevOps
* Working experience in Azure and strong knowledge in cloud Architecture strategy.
* Good Exposure in Cloud and Container Monitoring and logging and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of Cloud related concepts and technologies, and maintains an in\-depth knowledge of the area
* Experience designing and conducting research and experiments with recently developed technologies


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
description:
**Company Overview**
 At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one\-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi\-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
   

  

**THE TEAM \& ROLE**
 Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company\-wide. Taking a cloud\-first, AI\-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self\-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility \- all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
   

  

 Within Corporate Operations, the G\&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General \& Administrative functions, including Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
   

  

 The Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise\-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross\-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
   

  

 You’ll join a collaborative, high\-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION**
 As a senior technical anchor supporting all G\&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting\-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
   

  

**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
 As the Sr, Solutions Architect \- Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi\-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross\-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross\-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end\-to\-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G\&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high\-performing API\-based integrations, microservices, and file\-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2\.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI\-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field\-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).


**OUR TECH STACK:** 
 REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2\.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
   

  

**What You’ll Accomplish**
* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross\-system data points from disparate G\&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP\&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next\-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self\-service models.
* Advance Automation \& Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end\-to\-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure \& Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field\-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long\-term scalability and consistent cross\-functional operational excellence.


**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8\+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).

description:

**Career Family:** 
 AIA – AGENTIC AI ENGINEER
   

  

**Technology \- Cloud \& Data Engineering – Senior Associate Agentic Data Engineer (Healthcare)**
**The Opportunity**
 Healthcare is rapidly adopting Artificial Intelligence to improve patient outcomes, operational efficiency, and member experiences. As AI moves from experimentation into production, organizations need trusted, scalable, and AI\-ready data foundations that enable intelligent applications and agentic systems to deliver meaningful business value.
   

  

 Our Artificial Intelligence, Data and Engineering team helps healthcare organizations build modern cloud\-based data platforms that power analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and emerging agentic AI capabilities. As an Agentic Data Engineer, you will work alongside healthcare, cloud, and AI specialists to design, build, and support data solutions that enable secure, governed, and scalable AI adoption within payer and provider organizations.
   

  

 This role provides an opportunity to gain hands\-on experience with healthcare data, cloud technologies, interoperability standards, and AI\-enabled data platforms while working with leading healthcare clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You will contribute to the implementation of healthcare data platforms and AI\-ready data solutions, helping clients modernize their data ecosystems and accelerate AI adoption.

* Develop and maintain cloud\-based data pipelines to ingest, transform, validate, and process healthcare data from sources such as EHR/EMR systems, claims platforms, operational systems, and external healthcare data providers.

* Participate in healthcare interoperability initiatives involving standards such as FHIR, HL7, CDA/CCDA, APIs, and healthcare integration platforms.
* Assist in building data foundations that support AI and Generative AI use cases, including document processing, retrieval systems, vector databases, knowledge repositories, and governed data access patterns.
* Implement data quality checks, monitoring, observability, lineage, and governance controls within healthcare data pipelines.
* Work with cross\-functional teams including data engineers, AI engineers, architects, healthcare SMEs, and business stakeholders to deliver client solutions.

* Understanding of modern data engineering concepts including ETL/ELT, data modeling, data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, and cloud\-based analytics platforms.

* Interest in AI, Generative AI, and emerging agentic AI technologies and their application in healthcare use cases.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail.

* Willingness to learn healthcare regulations, interoperability standards, and industry\-specific data challenges.

* 3\-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Cloud Data Platforms, Analytics Engineering, AI Engineering, or related technology disciplines.
* 1\+ years of experience within healthcare, life sciences, health technology, payer, provider, or healthcare analytics environments.
* Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as FHIR, HL7, CDA/CCDA, X12, or healthcare terminology standards is preferred.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Experience working with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse Analytics, BigQuery, or Redshift.
* Proficiency in SQL and Python, with exposure to Spark or distributed data processing frameworks.
* Experience building data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines using modern data engineering tools.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, metadata management, and security controls.
* Exposure to AI/ML, Generative AI, vector databases, RAG architectures, or agentic AI concepts is preferred.
* Knowledge of healthcare privacy and compliance requirements such as HIPAA and PHI handling principles.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel based on client and project requirements.


**Ideally, You'll Also Have**

* Exposure to healthcare cloud services such as Azure Health Data Services, AWS HealthLake, Google Healthcare API, or industry accelerators from Databricks and Snowflake.

 3\-5 years

title: Senior Technical Consultant
description:
**About Workhall** 




 Workhall is a bootstrapped low\-code / no\-code enterprise workflow platform. We help large organisations model complex operations as configurable data structures, workflows, and reports, without the cost and drag of bespoke custom development. Today we serve 20\+ enterprise customers across India, Australia, and the Americas, in industries ranging from manufacturing, food and beverage, construction, trade, and private capital.
 



**About the role** 




 You will be the technical backbone that turns the Workhall platform into a working enterprise application. Sitting inside the professional services team, you own requirements gathering, solution design, solve the hard data\-modelling and integration problems that complex customers bring, and act as the deep technical reference point for our implementation partners.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on solutioning role for someone who is equally comfortable whiteboarding an architecture and configuring the platform themselves. You are not just advising from the sidelines. You design, you build, and you set the standard others follow.
 



**What you will do** 





 Solution design and architecture
 



* Own end\-to\-end solution design on the platform: datalists, workflows, roles and permissions, reports, and the expression logic that ties them together.
* Translate ambiguous enterprise requirements into robust, scalable, maintainable configurations rather than one\-off hacks.
* Make and defend data\-modelling decisions, including denormalization and relationship patterns, with an eye on performance and long\-term maintainability on a document\-database platform.




 Build and delivery
 



* Configure and build complex applications.
* Design and implement integrations between Workhall and external enterprise systems.
* Own the hardest technical parts of an implementation, and unblock delivery teams when they hit the limits of the platform or the data model.




 Customer and stakeholder engagement
 



* Run technical discovery workshops with enterprise customers, shape the application, and communicate trade\-offs to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor through an implementation, from design through go\-live and stabilisation.




 Partner enablement and quality
 



* Enable, review, and raise the quality bar for implementation partners so delivery stays consistent as we scale.
* Define reusable patterns, templates, and technical standards that the wider delivery ecosystem can adopt.




 What we are looking for
 



* Experience. 3 to 6 years in enterprise software implementation, solution consulting, or technical delivery, including meaningful time on low\-code / no\-code, BPM, or workflow automation platforms.
* Data modelling. Strong data\-modelling instincts and comfort with document or NoSQL databases; MongoDB experience is a clear advantage.
* Platform depth. Ability to reason about workflow logic, conditional expressions, and integrations from first principles, not just by copying prior examples.
* Communication. Customer\-facing maturity: you can run a workshop, defend a design decision, manage expectations, and say no well.
* Ownership. A track record of owning the technically hardest part of a project and getting it live.




 Nice to have
 



* Familiarity with LCNC platform, API design, scripting, or integration middleware.




 Why join us
 



* Ownership. Real ownership. We are a lean, bootstrapped team, so your work ships and your judgement counts from week one.
* Depth. Hard, interesting problems. Modelling messy enterprise operations into clean, reusable software is genuinely difficult and genuinely rewarding.
* Range. Breadth of exposure. You will work across regulated industries and global markets, not a single narrow use case.
* Leverage. A platform with leverage. What you build once serves many customers and many verticals.

title: Global Data Steward
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting\-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world\-class creativity, next\-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**
**We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100\+ markets, with deep local expertise.**
**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Why we're hiring:**
 We are seeking an experienced and detail‑oriented Global Data Steward to join our team in Chennai, India, supporting WPP Media’s global Master Data Management (MDM) initiative.
   

  

 This role plays a critical part in maintaining the integrity of WPP Media’s Golden Master Data assets across domains such as Clients, Media, Suppliers, and other core business entities. The role works hands‑on with AI‑assisted mastering and mapping in our internally developed MDM platform, Matrix.
   

  

 The role requires strong ownership, sound judgement, and an attitude focused on getting it right — not just getting it approved. The Global Data Steward is expected to actively drive data quality outcomes, challenge poor inputs or AI recommendations, and ensure that master data decisions are correct, intentional, and fit for long‑term enterprise use.
   

  

 As a Global Data Steward, you will work cross‑region with markets, finance teams, and global stakeholders. A structured, proactive, and assertive (“pushy when needed”) approach is essential to ensure mappings are completed, standards are met, and nothing critical stalls.
   

  

**What you'll be doing:**
* Review, validate, and approve AI‑generated mapping recommendations using WPP Media’s internal Matrix MDM tool.
* Apply strong judgement to ensure AI recommendations:
+ Correctly represent real‑world business entities.
+ Do not introduce duplication, fragmentation, or incorrect hierarchies.
+ Follow agreed global standards, naming conventions, and data models.

* Assess and approve new master data additions to the Golden List across multiple domains (e.g. Client, Media, Supplier).
* Actively drive and push local, market, and finance teams to:
+ Complete required mappings.
+ Resolve unclear or missing information.
+ Correct poor‑quality or inconsistent submissions.

* Challenge, reject, or return mappings and requests where data is incomplete, incorrect, or poorly justified.
* Take ownership of end‑to‑end stewardship flow, ensuring items do not stall in queues or wait indefinitely for market action.
* Provide structured feedback into Matrix to improve AI‑assisted mastering and stewardship efficiency over time.
* Serve as a guardian of data quality, consistency, and enterprise usability of master data.
* Collaborate closely with Local Data Stewards, Finance, Product, and Platform teams to ensure alignment on standards and expectations.
* Enforce and uphold data governance principles, approval workflows, and escalation paths.
* Escalate complex, disputed, or model‑level issues to the appropriate governance forum when required.
* Ensure all stewardship decisions are clearly documented, auditable, and transparent.


**What you'll need:**
* Experience in Master Data Management, data stewardship, data governance, or data quality roles, ideally in a global or multi‑market organization.
* Strong understanding of master data concepts including golden records, canonical entities, hierarchies, and deduplication.
* Experience working with MDM tools and approval workflows (experience with internally built tools is an advantage).
* Comfortable reviewing and challenging AI‑assisted or rule‑based mappings (no ML development required).
* Highly structured, organized, and comfortable pushing stakeholders to meet data quality and completion standards.
* Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to think long‑term and cross‑domain.
* Confident in saying “no”, “not yet”, or “this needs fixing” when quality is at risk.
* Clear communicator, able to interact effectively with business, finance, and technical teams.
* Experience operating within formal governance and decision‑authority models is a strong advantage.


**Additional Competencies We Strongly Recommend For This Role**
 Data Governance \& Control
   

  

* Understanding of stewardship layers (local vs global), decision authority, and escalation models.
* Appreciation for auditability, traceability, and consistency over speed.


 Stakeholder \& Execution Drive
   

  

* Comfortable chasing, reminding, and escalating when markets or teams do not complete required mappings.
* Able to balance collaboration with firmness to keep the master data agenda moving.


 Cross‑Domain Stewardship
   

  

* Ability to apply the same quality bar across multiple master data domains, not just one.


 Operational Ownership Mindset
   

  

* Sees stewardship as active ownership, not a review inbox.


 Proactively prevents backlogs, rework, and downstream impact.
   

  

**Who you are:**

title: Controls Tech EIM Database Lead / Database Engineering Lead
description:
**Position Overview**
 Citi is seeking an experienced, high\-caliber Database Technical Lead (C13 / VP) to lead the design, modernization, administration, and resiliency engineering of enterprise database platforms. As a C13 Database Lead, you will be responsible for defining technical strategies, driving cloud and database\-as\-a\-service (DBaaS) transformations, ensuring strict data governance and security compliance, and leading senior technical engineers across critical multi\-region banking systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Requirements**
* Enterprise Database Architecture \& Technical Strategy Architect, design, and deliver end\-to\-end database solutions across relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server) and NoSQL/Distributed databases (MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis). Define enterprise standards for data modeling, partitioning, indexing strategies, and database scalability across high\-volume transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) environments. Drive the technical roadmap aligned with Citi's enterprise reference architectures, zero\-trust infrastructure, and microservices ecosystem.
* Modernization, DBaaS \& Cloud Enablement Lead migration initiatives from legacy on\-premises databases to modern cloud and containerized platforms (AWS RDS/Aurora, OpenShift, internal private cloud DBaaS/PaaS). Champion database containerization and modern provisioning frameworks, automating lifecycle management and cluster autoscaling. Partner with application development and cloud architecture teams to re\-platform and refactor applications for cloud\-native persistence layers.
* High Availability, Replication \& Scalability Engineering Architect, configure, and maintain robust High Availability (HA) topologies (e.g., Oracle Data Guard/Active Data Guard, Oracle RAC, PostgreSQL Streaming Replication / Patroni, MongoDB Replica Sets \& Sharded Clusters). Establish cross\-region and multi\-data\-center replication strategies to support 24/7/365 mission\-critical banking operations with minimal RTO (Recovery Time Objective) and zero RPO (Recovery Point Objective).
* Advanced Performance Engineering, Tuning \& Diagnostics Spearhead deep\-dive performance troubleshooting, query optimization, indexing reviews, execution plan analysis, and database profiling across production systems. Establish automated monitoring, telemetry, and observability frameworks (using Prometheus, Grafana, OEM, AppDynamics, and APM tools) to proactively detect anomalies, locking/blocking, and resource bottlenecks. Direct proactive capacity planning, I/O footprint optimization, and memory management across compute and storage tiers.
* Security, Vulnerability Management \& Access Control Enforce end\-to\-end database security standards, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), data masking, tokenization, TLS encryption in\-transit, and privileged access controls. Drive automated security patching, configuration baseline compliance (CIS Benchmarks), and rapid remediation of vulnerabilities (CVEs), ensuring zero non\-compliant instances across the fleet. Integrate identity and credential workflows with enterprise secrets management tools (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk) and role\-based access control (RBAC).
* Database DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) \& CI/CD Champion Database DevOps practices by integrating schema migrations and database deployments into automated CI/CD pipelines (via Harness, Tekton, Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub). Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) playbooks and configuration scripts using Ansible, Terraform, and Python/Bash automation. Eliminate manual operational touchpoints through self\-service database provisioning and automated routine maintenance.
* Continuity of Business (COB) \& Disaster Recovery (DR) Own the disaster recovery framework for core database estates, designing and executing regular formal COB/DR failover drills. Define and maintain backup and restore strategies (RMAN, storage snapshots, point\-in\-time recovery) to safeguard data integrity against hardware failures, corruption, and site\-level disasters. Ensure comprehensive auditability and validation of backup retention policies aligned with financial regulatory standards.
* Governance, Risk, Audit \& Regulatory Compliance Serve as the primary database technical authority during internal and external audit reviews, regulatory examinations, and risk assessments. Ensure full compliance with Citi's Information Security policies, data sovereignty regulations (e.g., GDPR, local residency laws), and financial record retention mandates. Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, architecture runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational readiness checklists.
* Technical Leadership, Mentorship \& Vendor Engagement Provide strong technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to senior engineers, database administrators, and offshore support teams. Collaborate closely with application squads, enterprise architects, site reliability engineers (SREs), and product owners to translate complex business requirements into robust database architectures. Liaise with major database software vendors (Oracle, EnterpriseDB, MongoDB, AWS) on product escalations, feature enhancements, and roadmaps.
* Required Qualifications, Experience \& Certifications Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Experience: 12\+ years of progressive experience in database engineering/administration, with at least 3\+ years in a lead or architect capacity within a large\-scale, enterprise financial services environment. Core Technical Competencies: In\-depth expertise in Oracle (19c/21c, RAC, Data Guard) and/or PostgreSQL (v12\+, Patroni, Connection Pooling). Strong working proficiency with NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, Redis) and DBaaS architectures. Demonstrated hands\-on scripting and automation skills in Python, Bash, Ansible, or Terraform. Solid understanding of Linux kernel OS tuning, storage architectures (SAN/NAS/NVMe), and networking protocols. Certifications (Preferred): Certified Oracle Database Administrator / Specialist AWS Certified Database – Specialty or AWS Solutions Architect Professional PostgreSQL / EDB Certified Professional MongoDB Certified DBA Associate / Professional Key Leadership \& Soft Skills Proven track record of managing high\-impact technical incidents and driving root cause analysis (RCA) to conclusion. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical topics to non\-technical stakeholders and executive leadership. Strong ownership mindset, problem\-solving agility, and passion for continuous technology modernization.

title: DBT/Snowflake Engineer
description:
**Req ID:** 
 348694
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a DBT/Snowflake Engineer to join our team in Chennai, Tamil Nādu (IN\-TN), India (IN).
   

  

**Job Duties: Roles \& Responsibilities**
 Execute data validation queries to compare:
   

  

 Source (Yellowbricks / Informatica outputs) vs Target (Databricks / Snowflake / dbt outputs).
   

  

 Perform:
   

  

 Row\-count checks between source and target tables.
   

  

 Aggregate validations (sums, counts, averages, distinct counts, min/max).
   

  

 Sample and cell\-level comparisons for critical entities and fields.
   

  

 Validate schema consistency (data types, lengths, precision/scale, nullable fields, constraints).
   

  

 Log discrepancies, analyze patterns, and work with developers to support root\-cause analysis.
   

  

 Understand Informatica mappings and workflows and their expected outputs.
   

  

 Validate dbt models (staging, core, marts) on Snowflake against legacy Informatica outputs.
   

  

 Test Databricks notebooks/jobs that replicate Yellowbricks logic — ensuring correct transformations, joins, filters, and aggregations.
   

  

 Validate CDC / incremental loads: new, changed, and deleted records are handled correctly.
   

  

 Execute functional tests to verify correct application of business rules after migration.
   

  

 Perform regression testing for each migration wave to ensure that previously validated data and flows remain correct.
   

  

 Support integration testing across layers:
   

  

 Source → Databricks / Snowflake
   

  

 dbt → Snowflake → downstream reports or extracts
   

  

 Validate downstream outputs (if in scope): reports, extracts, or interfaces that consume migrated data.
   

  

 Assist in executing basic performance tests for key queries and jobs (e.g., comparing runtime vs baseline).
   

  

 Monitor pipeline runs for job failures, retries, and data volume anomalies.
   

  

 Execute test cases, record results, and maintain traceability to requirements.
   

  

 Log defects with clear steps, data samples, and evidence (screenshots/SQL) in the defect tracking tool (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps).
   

  

 Retest resolved defects and support regression runs.
   

  

 Maintain test case repositories, test data sets, and execution logs for audit and re\-use.
   

  

 Participate in daily stand\-ups / defect triage with onshore/offshore teams.
   

  

 Minimum Skills Required: Experience
   

  

 2\-4 years of experience in Software Testing / QA, with at least 2\+ years in Data Warehouse / ETL testing.
   

  

 Practical experience in data migration / data platform modernization projects is strongly preferred.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

 Strong SQL skills for writing complex queries and validations (joins, aggregations, window functions, filters).
   

  

 Hands\-on experience testing on at least one data platform such as:
   

  

 Snowflake, Databricks, or other cloud DW/Big Data platforms – experience with Snowflake/Databricks is a plus.
   

  

 Exposure to Informatica (understanding mappings/workflows and expected outputs).
   

  

 Exposure to dbt or willingness to learn dbt\-based validations (model outputs, dbt test results).
   

  

 Good understanding of data warehouse concepts: facts/dimensions, SCDs, aggregations, grain, source\-to\-target mapping.
   

  

 Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, JIRA, TestRail, qTest).
   

  

 Experience with Excel or similar tools for managing validation results and reconciliation artifacts.
   

  

**Soft Skills**
 Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to validation.
   

  

 Ability to analyze data discrepancies and collaborate with developers to narrow down issues.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
**About Connected Vehicle Data Platform**
 At Ford, data is at the heart of our transformation towards becoming a technology\-driven mobility company. Connected Vehicle Data Platform's mission is to build foundational, company\-wide systems and processes designed to intelligently collect, manage, control, and democratize all vehicle\-related data as key data products. Its purpose is to eliminate data fragmentation and duplication, enabling robust cloud and vehicle data capabilities that facilitate proactive issue identification, reduce regulatory penalties, recalls, and warranty claims, and ensure global compliance for evolving data use cases, especially for 2026 MY\+ vehicles.
   

  

**Summary**
 We are seeking a visionary Principal Engineer to serve as the technical authority for our Connected Vehicle Data Platform(200\+ engineering org), with a specific focus on
 **AI\-driven data architecture** 
 . In this role, you will bridge the gap between Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and Applied AI. You will drive the architectural vision for how we process massive streams of vehicle data and lead the implementation of
 **Agentic flows and AI agents** 
 to automate data collection, governance, and insight generation.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a "player\-coach" who remains hands\-on in the code while providing high\-level technical leadership. You will be responsible for designing resilient streaming architectures that leverage the latest in AI/ML to ensure our 2026 MY\+ vehicle data is not just stored but intelligently utilized to drive proactive business decisions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Grounds\-Up Streaming Re\-architecture: Lead the technical vision and execution for re\-building the connected vehicle streaming foundation. Replace legacy systems with a modern, high\-throughput, and low\-latency stack designed for global scale and efficiency.
* IC Leadership of Senior Talent: Act as the primary technical mentor and lead for the portfolio’s Staff and Senior Staff Engineers. Drive technical alignment across an 80\+ person engineering organization through RFCs, architecture reviews, and "Golden Path" implementations.
* Advanced Data Modeling: Define the standards for database and time\-series data modeling. Architect specialized schemas for high\-cardinality vehicle telemetry that balance high\-speed ingestion with cost\-effective, performant querying.
* Agentic Data Insights: Design and develop AI Agentic flows that revolutionize how Ford interacts with data. Move beyond static dashboards by building agents capable of autonomously "answering data questions" interpreting natural language queries to generate real\-time insights from billions of vehicle data points.
* AI\-Driven Efficiency: Architect systems where Applied AI/ML is used to drive massive efficiency gains. This includes intelligent data pruning, automated anomaly detection, and AI\-optimized compute resource allocation (GCP Dataflow/Dataproc).
* Agentic Data Collection: Develop autonomous agents for "Intelligent Ingestion," enabling self\-healing pipelines and automated metadata tagging to eliminate data fragmentation and ensure global compliance.
* Efficiency \& Cost Ownership: Lead the technical strategy for optimizing cloud unit economics. Drive architectural changes that significantly reduce the total cost of ownership (TCO) for vehicle data products while increasing reliability.


**Hands\-on Excellence:** 
 Maintain a high level of technical craft by prototyping the most difficult segments of the architecture and solving the portfolio’s most complex technical bottlenecks.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Education: Minimum – Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field. Preferred – Master’s or PhD in a highly technical field.
* Experience:10\+ years of professional experience in software and data engineering, with a proven track record of architecting large\-scale (Petabyte\-scale) streaming and distributed systems.
* IC Leadership: Demonstrated experience as a Staff or Senior Staff Engineer (or equivalent) providing technical leadership for large organizations (50\-100\+ engineers).
* Modeling Expertise: Expert\-level knowledge of Database Modeling (Relational, NoSQL) and specialized Time\-Series Data Modeling (e.g., handling high\-frequency sensor data, windowing, and compaction).
* AI \& Agentic Mastery: Deep hands\-on experience in Applied AI, including the development of Agentic workflows (e.g., LangChain, CrewAI) and utilizing LLMs to automate data exploration and insight generation.
* Streaming \& Cloud Stack: Expert proficiency in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically BigQuery, Dataflow, and Vertex AI. Mastery of Kafka or Pub/Sub for high\-throughput messaging.
* Efficiency Mindset: Proven ability to re\-drive architectures specifically for efficiency gains, cost reduction, and performance optimization in a cloud\-native environment.
* Modern Engineering Standards: Mastery of SDLC, MLOps, and LLMOps, with the ability to set the standard for testing, observability, and deployment of AI\-integrated data systems.
* Technical Sovereignty: As the lead IC for the portfolio, you have the autonomy to re\-drive the foundation of Ford’s connected vehicle future.
* Scale \& Complexity: Work with one of the world's largest and most complex IoT datasets.
* Innovation: Lead the industry move from "Data Pipelines" to "Agentic Data Ecosystems."
* Impact: Directly influence the safety, compliance, and efficiency of the 2026 MY\+ vehicle fleet.
* Join Us in Re\-driving the Future of Automotive Data at Ford!

description:

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

**The opportunity**
 We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Digital Engineering Team and you will work with multi\-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity, Health, Government, Power and Utilities, we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. Through diverse experiences, world\-class learning and individually tailored coaching you will experience ongoing professional development. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Engineer with 4–6 years of IT experience and strong expertise in Identity and Access Management (IAM), Windows Server platforms, and multi\-cloud integration (Azure, AWS, GCP). In this role, you will design, implement, and manage secure and scalable identity solutions, modernize Active Directory environments, and support enterprise hybrid cloud adoption. You will also drive automation, enforce compliance, and collaborate closely with architects, developers, and security teams to deliver enterprise\-grade solutions.
   

  

 EY Digital Engineering is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Digital Engineering practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY’s DE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Environment \& Platform Ownership
+ Lead day to day management of on prem and cloud environments, ensuring stable provisioning, configuration, and operational best practices.
+ Provide SME level guidance on architecture, platform optimization, and cross platform integrations.

* Identity \& Windows Platform Management
+ Manage and optimize IAM and Windows platforms including Active Directory, ADFS, Azure AD, AWS IAM, Google Identity, AD DS, DNS, DHCP, GPO, PKI.
+ Implement and support SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, federation, and hybrid identity integrations for SaaS and on prem applications.

* Incident, RCA \& Operational Leadership
+ Own high priority technical incidents, lead major incident bridges, and drive swift service restoration.
+ Deliver detailed RCA with corrective and preventive actions, ensuring operational excellence.

* Reliability, Monitoring \& SRE Practices
+ Improve service reliability through proactive monitoring, trend analysis, observability enhancements, and SLO/SLI tracking.
+ Reduce MTTR and strengthen uptime through SRE methodologies and data driven insights.

* Automation, IaC \& Cloud Integration
+ Architect and implement automation using PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible, Python/Shell.
+ Drive IaC, GitOps, config drift controls, self healing mechanisms, and automated policy enforcement across cloud and identity workloads.

* Modernization, Migration \& Lifecycle Management
+ Lead modernization programs, platform upgrades, identity transformations, cloud migrations, and EOL remediation efforts.
+ Conduct dependency mapping, cutover planning, post migration validation, and maintain updated asset inventories.

* Security, Compliance \& Governance
+ Enforce RBAC, least privilege, Zero Trust, and configuration standards across all platforms.
+ Ensure compliance with ISO, CIS, NIST, maintain audit readiness, and uphold ITSM processes (Incident, Problem, Change).

* Collaboration, Mentoring \& Stakeholder Engagement
+ Partner with architects, application teams, cybersecurity, and cloud teams to deliver secure and scalable solutions.
+ Provide L3 technical support, mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and develop high quality runbooks, SOPs, and knowledge sharing assets.
+ Present operational insights and reliability metrics to leadership to support data driven decisions.


**Required Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**
* 4–6 years of core experience across IAM, Windows, Linux/Unix, and Cloud, including AD/ADFS, Azure AD, AWS IAM, Google Identity, Windows Server, GPO, and PKI.
* Expert level Linux/Unix administration, including deep kernel tuning, performance debugging, advanced filesystem analysis, and OS level troubleshooting.
* Strong cloud engineering expertise across Azure/AWS/GCP—covering networking, compute, storage, IAM, hybrid connectivity, and platform security.
* Advanced scripting \& automation engineering using Shell, Bash, Python, PowerShell, Terraform, and Ansible, with ability to build reusable automation frameworks.
* Advanced patching \& vulnerability management, including patch strategy design, automated patch cycles, remediation workflows, and compliance enforcement.
* SRE driven reliability engineering, including SLO/SLI definition, error budgets, chaos testing exposure, proactive monitoring, MTTR reduction, and systemic issue elimination.
* Strong observability \& monitoring expertise using Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Dynatrace—able to build dashboards, alerting standards, and log pipelines.
* Security \& compliance grounding, including Zero Trust, RBAC, least privilege, MFA/SSO, federation, NIST/ISO/CIS benchmarks, and audit readiness.
* Hands on migration \& modernization experience, including provisioning workflow optimization, Windows/IAM/cloud migrations, EOL remediation, lifecycle upgrades, and environment cutovers.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Identity \& Access Administrator / Enterprise Administrator Expert.
* Familiarity with Okta, Ping Identity, CyberArk, or other IAM platforms.
* Experience in hybrid identity governance and compliance programs.


**Education:**
* Degree: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
