title: System Development Engineer I, Amazon
description:
**Description**
 Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the world’s largest e\-Commerce products catalog. We power the online buying experience for customers worldwide so they can find, discover, and buy anything they want. Our massively scaled out distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates on the billions of products across physical, digital, and services offerings. To achieve this, we develop the algorithms and build the systems and tools to ensure the safety of the selection and maximize their impact on the Amazon top\-line, all the while continuously growing the overall selection. We develop and apply technologies spanning parallel processing, storage, Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Image Recognition.
   

  

 You will be part of Services Support Team under Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) in ASCS Org. The mission of the Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) team is to provide a single point of contact for item\-related problems and issues related to all retail and merchant catalog. As a member of ASCS team, you’ll play a key role in driving Amazon’s business. You will be responsible for providing Service Level issue support to all ASCS Engineering teams who built tier 1\-3 systems and keep their software packages/configurations free from vulnerability, setup and monitor new metrics and alarms for their systems and drive root cause resolutions to the recurrent issues. You will build tools to improve operational efficiency.
   

  

 This role requires an individual with excellent System/Tool coding abilities along with AWS services understanding. The successful candidate will be a self\-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, have strong attention to detail, and will be comfortable accessing and working with data from multiple sources. The candidate should also have strong communication skills, enabling them to work with Engineering team to understand requirements and shape analytical deliverables. Candidate should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to work cross\-organizationally. A keen sense of ownership and drive is must. The role will work with a diverse set of data and cross\-functional teams as well as use data to drive process improvement. An ideal engineer is one who enjoys discovering and solving ambiguous problems, can quickly learn complex systems, and enjoys building actionable insights from data.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* You handle all incoming system and service tickets with responsibilities covering multiple products, features and services.
* Software deployment support in staging and production environments.
* Given a defined problem, you deliver a solution which is logical, maintainable, that uses appropriate technologies, and is delivered on time.
* You learn current engineering best practices and get their designs, code \& procedures reviewed, and incorporate feedback.
* You identify and scope problems and opportunities arising from technical discussions, calculate costs of proposed solutions, and make technical trade\-offs.
* You contribute to operational excellence and perform troubleshooting to resolve defects.
* Drive Company Wide Campaigns and keep the Compliance risks (SAS, Shepherd etc.) for ASCS systems under control.


 A day in the life
   

  

 Big Picture: Solve problems at their root, stepping back to understand the broader context
   

  

 Proactive: You display energy and initiative in solving problems.
   

  

 Adaptable: You undertake a variety of tasks willingly. You switch from complex to routine tasks when required. You adapt quickly to new technologies and products.
   

  

 Quality: You demonstrate appropriate quality and thoroughness.
   

  

 Integrity: You act with personal integrity at all times
   

  

**About The Team**
 Catalog Support and Programs (CSP) provides program management and WW user technical support as a single point of contact for issues related to catalog systems and tools. We own implementation of business logic and configurations for these services and systems. We increase selection by on\-boarding new vendors, integrating new catalog feeds and by configuring new marketplace, merchant and category setups. We drive strategic cross\-functional programs that span across multiple catalog engineering teams
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C\+\+, C\#, Rust
* Experience with Linux/Unix


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

* Proficiency in designing and deploying microservices architectures on cloud platforms

* Experience with inter\-service communication using Eventgrid,gRPC or Kafka


**Performance Optimization:**

* Expertise in .NET runtime (CLR) performance tuning, memory management (garbage collection), and SQL query optimization


**DevOps Practices and CI/CD:**

+ CI/CD tools: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure Pipelines, AWS CodePipeline, GCP Cloud Build
+ Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, AKS)
+ Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible

**Continuous Learning and Collaboration:**

title: Lead Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Arcadia is the AI\-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
   

  

 Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI\-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
 ****cut carbon****
 .
   

  

**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**
* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI\-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.


 Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits
* 
+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1\+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency


**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a Lead Engineer to be the technical anchor of our Growth \& Governance (GnG) squad in India — the team that acquires utility data from thousands of unreliable third\-party sources, extracts and audits it, and turns it into the trusted dataset the rest of the Arcadia platform is built on. Formats change without notice, sources fail silently, and correctness is visible to customers, so our core expertise is building systems that stay accurate against data that refuses to cooperate.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with real ownership. You will own architecture for one or more of our services, lead projects end to end, act as a second point of technical review alongside the Engineering Manager, and mentor a team of earlier\-career engineers.
   

  

 AI has moved where the hard part of engineering sits. Producing code is no longer the bottleneck; deciding whether the produced code is the
 **right**
 answer is. We are looking for someone already well ahead on AI\-driven development who also has the architectural judgment to reject its confident wrong answers — and to teach a team of earlier\-career engineers to do the same rather than defer to the model.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the architecture and technical direction of one or more services in our acquisition, extraction, and audit pipeline, and lead medium\-to\-large projects on them end to end
* Translate ambiguous problems into engineering\-ready designs, and decompose large efforts into pieces the team can build in parallel
* Act as a primary design and code reviewer — the second layer of judgment on AI\-assisted designs and pull requests, catching architectural drift and silent correctness defects early
* Set the bar for AI\-driven development on the squad — and bring your own view of what that should look like
* Own a category of reliability and technical\-debt work end to end, without derailing roadmap commitments
* Share in the squad's production support rotation for the services you own, and improve what pages us
* Mentor earlier\-career engineers: raise their design instincts, review quality, and independence
* Partner with Product, Operations, our Data Analytics Engineering team, and US\-based engineering counterparts to shape requirements and drive cross\-team initiatives


**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must\-Haves****
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8\+ years of software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, the majority building and operating backend or distributed systems in production
* A clear track record of owning projects end to end — from design through production — not just delivering assigned components
* Currently hands\-on. You have shipped production code within the last two years
* Experience with enterprise Java (Spring / Spring Boot preferred) and Python
* SQL and relational data modelling at depth — you have designed schemas that survived real growth, and debugged correctness problems in the data rather than only in the code
* Experience building and operating high\-volume data pipelines and third\-party integrations, where correctness matters as much as throughput
* Experience with event\-driven and asynchronous systems (streaming or queueing — Kinesis, Kafka, SQS or similar), including what goes wrong under retries and at\-least\-once delivery
* Deployed and operated systems on AWS or similar, on containerised platforms (Kubernetes / ECS)
* Production operability. You have owned services you were paged for — metrics and dashboards (Prometheus / Grafana, CloudWatch, Datadog or similar), structured logging, tracing, and alerts that fire on customer\-visible symptoms rather than on every anomaly
* Strong AI\-driven development practice. You work daily in agentic coding tools and are fluent at managing context and steering them across a large, unfamiliar codebase. AI is central to how this squad works, so you should already be ahead on it — with your own view of what good looks like and the judgment to know when the output isn't
* Architectural judgment. You can articulate the tradeoffs behind a design, choose the simpler option when it holds, and explain why you rejected the alternatives — including when the alternative came from a tool or from a more senior voice in the room
* Technical rigor. Testing strategy across the pyramid, observability and alerting built in rather than bolted on, security and maintainability treated as requirements
* Demonstrated mentorship. You've been the person a team goes to, and you've levelled others up
* Clear written and verbal communication. You write designs people can act on, and you work well with a distributed team across time zones
* Flexibility to join evening meetings up to \~8:30 PM IST to collaborate with US\-based counterparts


****Nice\-to\-Haves****
* Experience shipping AI/LLM\-backed features to production — latency, accuracy, cost, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop design
* Experience building SQL data pipelines (Snowflake \+ dbt preferred)
* Experience in the energy industry, or another domain requiring deep knowledge of messy, unreliable source data

title: Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
description:
**Job Description** 
 – Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
 



**Position** 
 : Oracle OCI Exadata Architect
 



**Experience** 
 : 12\+ Years
 



**Role Level:** 
 Architect / Lead SME
 



**Location** 
 : Chennai
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for an experienced Oracle OCI Exadata Architect with strong hands\-on expertise in designing, administering and supporting enterprise Oracle database environments on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
 



 The candidate must have strong experience with OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D), Exadata VM Clusters, Oracle Database 19c/23ai, RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, Exadata patching, performance tuning, OCI networking and disaster recovery.
 



 This is a hands\-on Architect/Lead SME role requiring strong technical leadership and the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Architect, administer and support OCI Exadata Database Service on Dedicated Infrastructure (ExaDB\-D).
 



 • Provision, configure and manage Exadata Infrastructure and Exadata VM Clusters.
 



 • Manage Exadata compute, memory, storage, database servers and storage servers, including capacity planning and resource optimization.
 



 • Plan and execute Exadata Infrastructure, VM Cluster, Grid Infrastructure and Database RU patching, including pre\-checks, validation and rollback planning.
 



 • Administer and troubleshoot Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, SCAN, VIP, listeners and database services.
 



 • Support Oracle Database 19c and 23ai, including patching, upgrades and migration activities.
 



 • Design and support Data Guard / Active Data Guard, RMAN backup/recovery and DR solutions.
 



 • Monitor and troubleshoot Exadata Storage Servers, cell services, flash/cache, I/O and database performance.
 



 • Perform performance analysis and tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor and Exadata performance metrics.
 



 • Perform regular health checks, capacity reviews, proactive monitoring and performance assessments.
 



 • Lead troubleshooting and RCA for critical P1/P2 production incidents and coordinate with Oracle Support for critical SRs.
 



 • Support database and workload migrations from on\-premises or other Oracle platforms to OCI Exadata.
 



 • Work closely with Oracle DBA, EBS Apps DBA, OCI, middleware, network and security teams.
 



**OCI Infrastructure \& Networking** 




 Strong working knowledge of OCI infrastructure supporting Exadata environments, including:
 



 VCN \& Subnets \| Client \& Backup Networks \| NSGs \| Security Lists \| Route Tables \| DRG \| DNS/SCAN \| FastConnect \| Site\-to\-Site VPN \| OCI IAM \| Vault/KMS \| OCI Monitoring \| Alarms \| Object Storage \| TDE
 



 The candidate should be capable of troubleshooting application\-to\-database, RAC, on\-premises\-to\-OCI and network latency/connectivity issues.
 



**Required Technical Skills** 




 OCI Exadata / ExaDB\-D \| Exadata VM Clusters \| Oracle Database 19c \& 23ai \| Oracle RAC \| Grid Infrastructure \| ASM \| Data Guard \| RMAN \| Exadata Patching \| AWR/ASH \| Performance Tuning \| OCI Networking \| Linux \| Backup \& Recovery \| DR \| Database Migration \| Patching \& Upgrades
 



 Experience supporting large enterprise Oracle database environments is required.
 



 Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.2 running on OCI Exadata will be an added advantage.
 



**Preferred Certifications** 




 Relevant Oracle certifications are preferred, particularly:
 



 • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
 



 • Oracle Cloud Database Services Professional
 



 • Oracle Database Administration OCP / Professional
 



 • Relevant Oracle Database 23ai certification
 



 • Relevant Oracle Exadata, OCI Networking, Security or Migration certifications
 



**Candidate Profile** 




 The candidate should be a hands\-on OCI Exadata Architect / Lead SME, not limited to architecture or OCI networking.
 



 Strong experience in Exadata administration, VM Cluster management, Exadata patching, RAC/ASM, performance troubleshooting and production operations is essential.
 



 The role requires strong communication, customer\-facing, troubleshooting and documentation skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, production incidents, architecture reviews, migrations, patching and performance optimization in an enterprise managed\-services environment.

* Design and support Data Guard / Active Data Guard, RMAN backup/recovery and DR solutions.
* Monitor and troubleshoot Exadata Storage Servers, cell services, flash/cache, I/O and database performance.
* Perform performance analysis and tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor and Exadata performance metrics.
* Perform regular health checks, capacity reviews, proactive monitoring and performance assessments.
* Lead troubleshooting and RCA for critical P1/P2 production incidents and coordinate with Oracle Support for critical SRs.
* Support database and workload migrations from on\-premises or other Oracle platforms to OCI Exadata.
* Work closely with Oracle DBA, EBS Apps DBA, OCI, middleware, network and security teams.


**OCI Infrastructure \& Networking**
 Strong working knowledge of OCI infrastructure supporting Exadata environments, including:
   

  

 VCN \& Subnets \| Client \& Backup Networks \| NSGs \| Security Lists \| Route Tables \| DRG \| DNS/SCAN \| FastConnect \| Site\-to\-Site VPN \| OCI IAM \| Vault/KMS \| OCI Monitoring \| Alarms \| Object Storage \| TDE
   

  

 The candidate should be capable of troubleshooting application\-to\-database, RAC, on\-premises\-to\-OCI and network latency/connectivity issues.
   

  

**Required Technical Skills**
 OCI Exadata / ExaDB\-D \| Exadata VM Clusters \| Oracle Database 19c \& 23ai \| Oracle RAC \| Grid Infrastructure \| ASM \| Data Guard \| RMAN \| Exadata Patching \| AWR/ASH \| Performance Tuning \| OCI Networking \| Linux \| Backup \& Recovery \| DR \| Database Migration \| Patching \& Upgrades
   

  

**Experience Supporting Large Enterprise Oracle Database Environments Is Required.**
 Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite R12\.2 running on OCI Exadata will be an added advantage.
   

  

**Preferred Certifications**
 Relevant Oracle certifications are preferred, particularly:
   

  

* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
* Oracle Cloud Database Services Professional
* Oracle Database Administration OCP / Professional
* Relevant Oracle Database 23ai certification
* Relevant Oracle Exadata, OCI Networking, Security or Migration certifications


**Candidate Profile**
 The candidate should be a hands\-on OCI Exadata Architect / Lead SME, not limited to architecture or OCI networking.
   

  

 Strong experience in Exadata administration, VM Cluster management, Exadata patching, RAC/ASM, performance troubleshooting and production operations is essential.

title: Senior Technical Infrastructure Manger
description:
Who are Inchcape?
   

  

 At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations.
   

  

 We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills \& experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.
   

  

 Job Purpose :
   

  

 As a key part of the infrastructure discipline within the IT Ops function in Inchcape, you will be responsible for managing our core technology systems as a product, aligning with our business goals and managing teams, budgets, planning, design, implementation and maintenance of the foundational IT environment.
   

  

 The role involves managing the BAU infrastructure services function, delivering projects such as new services, mergers and acquisitions, cloud migrations and equipment refresh and budget management. While also maintaining/monitoring the existing applications and server environment in place.
   

  

 Duties and Responsibilities :
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Strategic Planning: Product management, develop long\-term roadmaps, ensuring scalability, and aligning IT infrastructure with business objectives.
* System Oversight: Manages Cloud, software, licences, networks, servers, storage, databases, and security systems across our global network and SaaS services.
* Security \& Compliance: Enforces security standards, manage firewalls, monitors for breaches, and ensures regulatory compliance.
* Team management: Leads and mentors IT teams, fosters collaboration, and coordinates with other departments. Team Consists of Wintel, Desktop and DevOps Engineers, performance appraisals, setting goals and objectives, ensuring 24/7 on\-call and support availability.

* Budget \& Performance: Manages IT budgets, tracks key performance indicators (KPIs), and optimizes system performance.
* Project Management: Oversees infrastructure projects, including planning, timelines, staffing, and implementation.


 Key Focus Areas
   

  

* Stability \& Availability: Ensures systems run optimally with high uptime.
* Data Security: Protects valuable organizational data.
* Scalability: Prepares infrastructure for future growth and increased demands.
* Business Alignment: Translates technical needs into business language, ensuring technology supports goals.


 Essential skils and Experience :
   

  

* Cloud platforms: Deep knowledge of major cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, SharePoint, Windows, Linux, Hybrid, M365 (including M365 AD Sync and Entra ID inc. B2B and B2C), and AWS (Control Tower, Landing Zone, AD Sync, EC2, Backup, VPC, Transit Gateway, S3, CloudTrail and CloudWatch) DR/Business continuity testing.
* Automation and scripting: Experience with tools like Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, and Python.
* Infrastructure fundamentals: Strong understanding and implementation of best practices on Cloud (AWS, Azure) and core infrastructure concepts like networking, servers, storage, backups.
* Security: Experience with security best practices, vulnerability management, and access control. Ensuring systems are patched monthly. MFA and Conditional Access.
* Leadership: Proven ability to lead technical teams and manage projects. Be a point of escalation in and out of hours
* Problem\-solving: Analytical and systematic approach to diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure issues. Lead on Problem analysis to resolution.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders and report to senior management.

* Licensing: Experience of MS licensing and the different licensing models


 Qualification :
   

  

* Experience: 8\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, systems, or network roles.
* Qualifications: AWS Solutions Architect, CompTIA A\+. MS 365 Endpoint Administrator Endpoint, CCNA.
* Hybrid environments: Experience with hybrid cloud models.
* Databases: Knowledge of database systems (e.g., MS SQL, AWS Postgres)

 Other requirements :
   

  

* Ability to travel (national and international) and work flexibility
* Able to work from home
* Able to work aligned to UK Hours
* Willing to work unsociable hours and be part of the on\-call rotas.

To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realise the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry.

description:
**Job Description** 




 Enterprise Platform Administrator / Consultant – ServiceNow \& Salesforce
 



 Position Overview
 



 We are looking for an
 **Enterprise Platform Administrator / Consultant** 
 with hands\-on knowledge of
 **ServiceNow and Salesforce** 
 to configure, administer, automate, integrate, and continuously improve enterprise service management and customer operations platforms.
 



 The successful candidate will work across both platforms, translating business requirements into scalable configurations, workflows, integrations, and governed platform solutions. The role requires a strong understanding of
 **IT Service Management (ITSM), CRM, platform administration, automation, scripting, data security, integration, testing, and release management** 
 .
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 ServiceNow Administration \& Configuration
 


* Administer and configure ServiceNow instances, including tables, forms, lists, roles, groups, ACLs, notifications, and scoped applications.
* Configure and support ITSM processes including:
* Incident Management
* Problem Management
* Change Enablement
* Request Fulfilment
* Service Level Management
* Work with the CMDB and Common Service Data Model to maintain service\-aware processes.
* Configure UI and data policies, client scripts, business rules, notifications, and other platform components.
* Develop and maintain ServiceNow applications using Studio and App Engine Studio.
* Build workflows and automations using Flow Designer and IntegrationHub.
* Configure Service Catalog items, record producers, approvals, and Virtual Agent topics.
* Develop and troubleshoot server\-side scripts using GlideRecord and related ServiceNow APIs.
* Create and consume REST APIs and work with Import Sets and Transform Maps.



 Salesforce Administration \& Development
 


* Configure Salesforce objects, fields, record pages, relationships, profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, and field\-level security.
* Design scalable Salesforce data models using lookup, master\-detail, and junction relationships.
* Build business automation using Salesforce Flow Builder.
* Configure validation rules, duplicate management, approval processes, reports, and dashboards.
* Develop Apex classes, triggers, and automation where declarative capabilities are insufficient.
* Write efficient SOQL queries and bulk\-safe DML operations.
* Develop and maintain Lightning Web Components.
* Implement appropriate unit testing and asynchronous processing.



 Integration \& Data Synchronisation
 


* Design and implement integrations between ServiceNow and Salesforce.
* Work with authenticated APIs, OAuth 2\.0, named credentials, callouts, and platform events.
* Design canonical data models and appropriate integration patterns.
* Configure and support middleware/orchestration solutions such as
 **n8n or MuleSoft** 
 .
* Design conflict\-safe data synchronisation, including duplicate, retry, loop, and failure handling.
* Monitor integrations and troubleshoot data and API issues.



 Governance, Testing \& Release Management
 


* Follow platform governance and enterprise architecture standards.
* Manage platform changes across development, testing, and production environments.
* Work with ServiceNow Update Sets and Salesforce Change Sets/packages.
* Develop and execute automated and unit tests.
* Support release pipelines and controlled deployment processes.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, integration documentation, and solution designs.
* Participate in design reviews and platform governance forums.
* Consider licensing, platform cost, maintainability, security, and upgrade impact when proposing solutions.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* Hands\-on experience with
 **ServiceNow administration/configuration** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with
 **Salesforce administration/configuration** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **ITIL 4 and ITSM concepts** 
 .
* Understanding of CRM processes and enterprise customer operations.
* Experience with ServiceNow:
* Tables and forms
* Roles and ACLs
* Flow Designer
* Service Catalog
* Business Rules
* Client Scripts
* GlideRecord
* IntegrationHub
* REST APIs
* Import Sets / Transform Maps
* CMDB
* Experience with Salesforce:
* Objects and data modelling
* Profiles and Permission Sets
* Sharing and security
* Flow Builder
* Apex
* SOQL
* Triggers
* Lightning Web Components
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and integration patterns.
* Experience with Git and version\-control practices.
* Experience using tools such as
 **Postman and Visual Studio Code** 
 .
* Ability to analyse business requirements and translate them into platform solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.



 Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills
 


* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or relevant ServiceNow certification.
* Salesforce Administrator certification and/or Salesforce Platform Developer certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow App Engine Studio.
* Experience with Salesforce CLI.
* Experience with GitHub Actions or CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform or n8n.
* Knowledge of Common Service Data Model (CSDM).
* Experience designing cross\-platform integrations.
* Familiarity with automated testing and enterprise release management.
* Basic JavaScript or Python knowledge.



 Educational Qualification
 


* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional certifications in ServiceNow, Salesforce, ITIL, or enterprise platforms are an advantage.



 Key Competencies
 


* Enterprise platform thinking
* ITSM and CRM process understanding
* Platform configuration and administration
* Workflow and process automation
* Scripting and application development
* API and systems integration
* Data modelling and security
* Troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis
* Testing and quality assurance
* Release and change management
* Technical documentation
* Stakeholder and business communication



 Typical Deliverables
 


* Configured ServiceNow and Salesforce platform components
* ITSM workflows and automation
* Salesforce flows and business automation
* Scripts, Apex, and Lightning Web Components
* ServiceNow–Salesforce integrations
* Data synchronisation mechanisms
* Test cases and automated tests
* Technical and configuration documentation
* Deployment packages and release documentation
* Platform governance and support documentation



 Success Profile
 



 The ideal candidate is comfortable working
 **between business processes and technology** 
 . They should be able to understand a business requirement, determine which platform should own the process or data, configure the solution where possible, develop code where necessary, integrate systems safely, test the result, and deploy it through a controlled release process.
 



 This role is particularly suited to professionals working as
 **Platform Administrators, Enterprise Consultants, ServiceNow Administrators, Salesforce Administrators, Platform Developers, or Cross\-Platform Technology Consultants** 
 .

title: SAP SD
description:
**Job Summary**
 GeoSpatial Analyst MAP with extensive expertise in SAP SD Testing and SAP SD will analyze complex geographic and sales distribution data to enhance supply chain performance in a hybrid work model. The role focuses on optimizing routes territories and order fulfillment processes collaborating across business and technology teams to drive efficient consumer goods distribution and support strategic decision making.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyze spatial data from enterprise systems to derive actionable insights that optimize sales distribution patterns and supply chain flows across diverse geographic regions ensuring efficient product availability for customers and stakeholders.
* Design and maintain geospatial models that integrate SAP SD transactional data with location intelligence to improve order routing delivery planning and regional demand forecasting for business units.
* Collaborate with SAP SD testers and business analysts to validate end to end data flows between geospatial solutions and SAP SD modules ensuring accuracy of pricing delivery and customer master information across markets.
* Develop and refine reusable test scenarios and data sets for SAP SD Testing that incorporate geospatial attributes enabling robust validation of territory assignments shipping conditions and logistic routes.
* Evaluate complex supply chain processes for consumer goods using map based analytics identifying bottlenecks in transportation warehousing and last mile delivery and recommending data driven improvements.
* Create detailed dashboards and map visualizations that present key performance indicators related to order fulfillment regional sales performance and supply chain disruptions in formats that are easy for business teams to interpret.
* Coordinate with demand planning distribution and customer service teams to ensure geospatial analysis aligns with real world constraints such as service level expectations inventory positioning and carrier capacities.
* Document geospatial analysis methods data transformations and SAP SD Testing approaches in clear technical narratives that support audit readiness knowledge transfer and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Assess the impact of new business rules and configuration changes in SAP SD on geospatial models recommending updates to algorithms and data structures that preserve consistency and reliability of insights.
* Automate data extraction and quality checks for geospatial and SAP SD data sources using approved tools reducing manual effort and increasing timeliness of reporting for supply chain and commercial stakeholders.
* Support continuous enhancement of hybrid work practices by enabling secure remote access to geospatial tools maintaining performance standards for map rendering and ensuring responsive collaboration with onsite teams.
* Participate in cross functional workshops to translate strategic supply chain goals into geospatial use cases prioritizing initiatives that improve sustainability reduce waste and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Provide thought guidance on emerging trends in geoanalytics and digital supply chain proposing practical pilots that use existing SAP SD and mapping capabilities to create measurable business impact.


**Qualifications**
* Bring strong experience in SAP SD Testing with deep understanding of order to cash pricing delivery processing and data integrity concepts applied to complex enterprise landscapes.
* Demonstrate advanced practical knowledge of SAP SD configuration and processes including customer master data material listings shipping conditions and billing flows relevant to geospatial analysis.
* Apply proven expertise in supply chain management to interpret logistics networks service levels and inventory strategies translating them into meaningful geospatial models and metrics.
* Offer solid exposure to consumer goods supply chains including channel structures promotion driven demand variation and distribution patterns that influence geospatial optimization opportunities.
* Utilize strong skills in geospatial data analysis and mapping tools to manage large spatial data sets perform proximity and route analyses and present insights in clear visual narratives.
* Employ disciplined testing and documentation practices including test case design defect tracking and root cause analysis ensuring that geospatial and SAP SD solutions meet quality expectations.
* Communicate effectively with technical and business partners synthesizing complex spatial and SAP SD information into transparent explanations that support informed decision making.


**Certifications Required**
 SAP SD certification plus any recognized geospatial or GIS analytics certification such as ESRI or equivalent.

title: Senior Oracle GoldenGate Data Replication Engineer / Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Oracle GoldenGate Data Replication Engineer / Architect to design, implement, and support real\-time and near real\-time data replication and CDC solutions using Oracle GoldenGate Microservices Architecture and Oracle GoldenGate Big Data Adapters.
   

  

 The role will focus on homogeneous and heterogeneous replication across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data platforms, with particular emphasis on Oracle and SQL Server migrations to Snowflake using Oracle GoldenGate Big Data DAA Adapters.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement enterprise\-grade Oracle GoldenGate replication, CDC, and migration architectures.
* Install, configure, patch, upgrade, and administer Oracle GoldenGate Microservices components, including Extract, Replicat, Distribution Service, Receiver Service, Service Manager, trails, checkpoints, and credential stores.
* Configure Oracle GoldenGate Big Data Adapters and DAA connectors for Snowflake, BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data lake integrations.
* Implement initial load, continuous synchronization, and CDC MERGE patterns for migrations into Snowflake.
* Support homogeneous and heterogeneous replication across Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and cloud platforms.
* Monitor replication latency, throughput, and availability; troubleshoot capture, delivery, trail, and performance issues.
* Prepare architecture diagrams, technical designs, deployment standards, runbooks, and operational procedures.
* Support migration planning, cutover, rollback, incident resolution, and production support activities.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 8\+ years of hands\-on Oracle GoldenGate implementation, administration, and production support experience.
* Strong expertise in Oracle GoldenGate 19c, 21c, and 23ai, including Microservices Architecture, Integrated Extract, Classic Extract, Integrated Replicat, Parallel Replicat, Coordinated Replicat, and Big Data Adapters.
* Experience with Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Kafka, and cloud data platforms.
* Strong understanding of CDC, heterogeneous replication, data migration, high availability, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Snowflake ingestion patterns including stage\-based loading, continuous replication, and MERGE\-based CDC processing.
* Good knowledge of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, data lake, and Lakehouse architecture concepts.
* Strong Linux/Unix administration, shell scripting, SQL, Python, and automation skills.


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 A senior data integration specialist capable of leading enterprise CDC and migration initiatives using Oracle GoldenGate Microservices Architecture and Big Data DAA Connectors, with a strong focus on secure, scalable, high\-availability replication into Snowflake and other modern analytics platforms.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Kinaxis**
 Are you looking to join an innovative, market\-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
   

  

 In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best\-in\-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
   

  

 Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end\-to\-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
   

  

**Location**
 Chennai / Bangalore \- India
   

  

 Work Model \- Hybrid
   

  

**About The Role**
 Kinaxis is building a Forward Deployed Engineers team whose singular mission is to Help customer transform how work gets done in the Agentic Age. This is not a consulting role, and it is not a features team. It is a Multi deployment unit embedded, operating with the speed and ownership culture of a startup.
   

  

 This team operates as a POD inside Kinaxis — a small, tight unit with end\-to\-end ownership and a startup mentality inside a larger company. We are scrappy, resourceful, and self\-directed. We move fast, trade tasks to whoever is closest to the need, and stay relentlessly focused on customer impact.
   

  

 You will work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers — from warehouse floor to executive sponsor — designing, building, and shipping Agentic AI solutions on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform. When a solution works, you abstract it into a reusable pattern. When something breaks in production, you own the fix. You operate in a POD team: tight, multi\-disciplinary, and self\-directed.
   

  

 💡 Attitude is the biggest asset. We hire for trajectory and mindset, not years on a resume. The right bias to action, ownership, and appetite to keep learning cannot be taught — but every technical skill here can be. Bring those, and we will invest in the rest.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Build the data backbone for AI Agents on Maestro**
* Design, build, and operate production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — that feed agentic AI workflows on the Kinaxis Maestro Platform.
* Integrate customer data sources (ERP systems, data warehouses, supply chain applications, flat files, APIs) into a unified data layer that agents can reason over reliably.
* Build and maintain data platform services, tooling, and infrastructure that enable reliable data ingestion, processing, sharing, and discovery across customer deployments.
* Own data quality end\-to\-end: profiling, validation, anomaly detection, and lineage — because an agent is only as good as the data behind it.


**Ship AI Agents alongside the POD**
* Partner with AI\-focused FDEs to design, develop, and ship agentic AI workflows — including multi\-agent orchestration, RAG pipelines, and tool\-use patterns — ensuring the data layer is production\-ready.
* Translate messy, real\-world customer data landscapes into clean, well\-modeled foundations that agents can consume — iterating rapidly from prototype to deployment.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across the full stack data pipelines, model context, API layers, and infrastructure — in live customer environments.


**Own the full solution lifecycle**
* Carry multiple customer engagements in parallel; set expectations early, renegotiate honestly when priorities shift, and own outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Define and track success in business terms: data freshness SLAs, pipeline reliability, query performance, exception rates — not just deployment completion.
* Drive platform engineering best practices through Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD automation, observability, and automated testing across customer deployments.


**Work inside a POD team**
* Operate as part of a small, self\-directed POD within Kinaxis tasks traded fluidly to whoever has the right skills, focus maintained with urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to convert field learnings and repeatable data patterns into durable platform capabilities, not one\-off scripts.
* Serve as the technical face of the team in customer rooms — from IC\-level engineers to skeptical architects to VP sponsors and build genuine trust across all of them.


**Drive adoption and change**
* Guide customer data teams through solution transitions: the new data architecture has to stick, not just ship.
* Mentor customer teams on modern data engineering practices, agentic data workflows, and new operating patterns so capability transfers and does not remain dependent on you.


****What we are looking for****
**Bias to action**
 You move on what matters. You finish what you start. The outcome is yours — no waiting for perfect clarity.
   

  

**Self\-directed**
 You identify what matters, secure the help or learning you need, and deliver — without being told.
   

  

**Always learning**
 Every customer, teammate, and new tool is a chance to level up. Not knowing something is fine; refusing to learn it is not.
   

  

**Customer\-obsessed**
 You can sit with a frustrated VP, a skeptical architect, or a junior analyst — and leave each one feeling heard, helped, and impressed.
   

  

**Comfortable with ambiguity**
 Undefined problem, undefined scope, undefined success metric — and you still ship.
   

  

**Drives change, not just code**
 You guide customers through transitions and mentor their teams to adopt new ways of working.
   

  

 The following are the technical areas we look for. You do not need depth in all of them — we look for strong foundations, a growth trajectory, and the ability to pick up what is missing quickly.
   

  

**Data Engineering \& Platforms (Primary)**
* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating production data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Spark, Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Deep working knowledge of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar), including Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning at scale.
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of data modeling, schema design, and large\-scale data processing patterns.
* Experience with data governance practices: RBAC, PII handling, data lineage, data quality frameworks, and enterprise\-scale data management.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, or AWS) and Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar).
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments — you have untangled broken pipelines at 2 AM and lived to tell the tale.


**AI \& Agentic Development**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based applications — RAG systems, multi\-agent workflows, tool\-use patterns, prompt and context engineering.
* Familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development tools (Copilot, Claude Code, agentic IDE workflows) as daily practice, not novelty.
* Understanding of agentic orchestration patterns — when to use single vs. multi\-agent architectures, how to handle memory and state.


**Software Engineering**
* Solid, hands\-on software engineering fundamentals: you have built and shipped real systems, not just scripts.
* Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred) and the ability to read and contribute across a polyglot codebase.
* Experience with REST and streaming APIs, authentication patterns, and integration with enterprise systems.


**Data Engineering \& Platforms**
* Ability to build and maintain data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, serving, and monitoring — using tools such as Airflow, Kafka, dbt, or equivalents.
* Working familiarity with modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or similar), including data modeling and performance fundamentals.
* Strong debugging instincts with imperfect, real\-world data in production environments.


**Supply Chain Domain (Nice to Have)**
* Prior exposure to supply chain planning, logistics, or operations domains is a genuine plus — not a requirement.
* Experience with or curiosity about platforms like Kinaxis, SAP IBP, o9, or Blue Yonder is welcome context.


**Experience \& Background**
* 3 – 6 years of professional experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, software engineering, or a technical\-founder role. Strong candidates at either end of that range are welcome to apply.
* Prior exposure to customer\-facing technical roles — solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a startup where you wore multiple hats — is a strong signal, though not a requirement.


**How You Will Succeed In This Role**
* You measure your own success in business outcomes — efficiency gains, exception reduction, SLA improvements — not lines of code shipped.
* You bring field learnings back into the platform, helping abstract what works into durable, scalable capabilities.
* You operate with high agency: you unblock yourself, adapt when conditions change, and take ownership end\-to\-end without requiring close supervision.
* You are curious and pragmatic — you explore new tools and apply them where they create real value, not because they are new.
* You communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business stakeholders — written, verbal, and in the room.


**\#Fulltime, \#Full\-time** 
**\#Associate**
**Work With Impact:** 
 Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
   

  

**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:** 
 Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P\&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
   

  

**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:** 
 Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long\-term net\-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
   

  

 People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
   

  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company\-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well\-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons


 For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
   

  

 Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
   

  

 Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

 Architect and build custom Artificial Intelligence (AI) infrastructure/hardware solutions. **Role Summary / Description**
 As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end\-to\-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI\-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI\-ready data/feature pipelines, model\-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost\-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake\-based AI infrastructure solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI\-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
   

  

 Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high\-throughput data access design.
   

  

 Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
   

  

 Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade\-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
   

  

 Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
   

  

 Drive architecture decision\-making by documenting rationale, trade\-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
   

  

 Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
   

  

 Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
   

  

 Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
   

  

 Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
   

  

 Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large\-scale engineering solutions.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
   

  

 Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform\-native workflow tooling.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
   

  

 Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large\-scale solutions.
   

  

 Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Strong hands\-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
   

  

 Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model\-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.

 Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.

 Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials.

title: Data & IT Cost Analyst
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Data \& IT Cost Analyst
   

  

**Department** 
 : IT CARATS
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 BNP Paribas Cardif is the insurance subsidiary of BNP Paribas. We are a worldwide leader of the Credit Protection Insurance market with strong positions in savings and protection insurance in more than 30 countries in Europe, Asia and Latin America.
   

  

 The IT Asset Management and Optimization (ITAMO) service within the IT Department is responsible for managing IT assets to improve control over operational risks and costs. This service globally oversees Cardif’s asset registers and IT management tools to support compliance and risk‑management requirements for our IT activities and to control spending and investments related to our IT footprint. In this regard, the service monitors the health of IT assets by identifying critical components (under‑utilization, toxicity, etc.), helps reduce software spending through the rationalization of publisher contracts and usage, and finally facilitates the identification of optimizations for infrastructure‑service expenditures delivered by the Group’s IT providers.
   

  

**Position Purpose**
 Data \& IT Cost Analyst – GIE BNPP Cardif (Confirmed)
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced cost control\-oriented Data Analyst to join our IT team.
   

  

 In this role, you sit at the intersection of data analytics and financial operations, with a clear mandate: bring visibility, rigor, and actionable intelligence to IT infrastructure costs across our application and server assets (PROD and non\-PROD environments).
   

  

 You will own the full cost analytics cycle — from data collection and modelling, through trend analysis and anomaly detection, to executive\-level reporting and recommendation delivery.
   

  

 Your work will directly influence infrastructure spending decisions and resource optimization strategies across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

**Cost \& Resource Analytics**
* Analyse and interpret data related to applications, servers, and PROD / non\-PROD environments, covering:
* Technical unit consumption volumes — CPU, memory, storage, bandwidth, etc.
* Cost attribution — server costs, storage costs, network costs, and associated resource expenditure.
* Application and server performance — response times, availability rates, SLA compliance.
* Identify cost trends, consumption anomalies, and financial risk signals across the IT estate, and translate them into concrete optimisation recommendations.
* Build cost allocation models and showback/chargeback frameworks to provide accurate visibility of IT spending by team, application, or service.
* Monitor budget vs. actual consumption and flag deviations proactively to relevant stakeholders.


 Dashboard Development \& Reporting
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that present cost and performance data to both operational teams and senior leadership.
* Ensure dashboards provide real\-time or near\-real\-time visibility into spending patterns, capacity usage, and efficiency KPIs.

 Full\-Time

 CohnReznick Advisory LLC, founded in 1919 and headquartered in New York City, is an accounting, auditing, and financial advisory firm. The company provides services in accounting advisory, tax consultancy, assurance services, real estate advisory, and transaction advisory. CohnReznick is recognized for its expertise in various sectors and its ability to deliver strategic advisory, audit, and tax solutions that enhance business performance and compliance
   

  

 We have recently gone live with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and are at the foundational stage of our journey. This role is critical in elevating our SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ecosystem by driving automation, optimizing workflows, and introducing innovative solutions that unlock the full potential of the platform. If you thrive on transforming systems from “live” to “best\-in\-class,” this is your opportunity to make a significant impact.

 The SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud Administrator is responsible for the administration, optimization, integration, and support of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and its connected third\-party financial and operational applications, including Replicon, Concur, Unanet, Rillion, and Workday Adaptive Planning. This role ensures system reliability, integration integrity, and process excellence across all platforms supporting the firm’s financial, operational, and project\-management workflows.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide user support, troubleshooting, and escalations across SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and all supported third‑party tools.
* Manage system settings, approval workflows, financial mappings, audit rules, and cost structures across all platforms.
* Validate cross\-platform financial flows (e.g., time → project costing → revenue recognition; expenses → AP postings; forecasts → Adaptive).
* Serve as primary liaison with software vendors for escalations, service tickets, and system enhancements.
* Review vendor release notes, assess impacts, and coordinate testing.
* Identify and implement workflow improvements (e.g., Replicon time accuracy, Concur T\&E automation, Rillion AP automation).
* Ensure cross\-system alignment of financial data, project structures, customers, vendors, GL accounts, and cost centers.
* Support financial reporting and planning cycles by ensuring accurate data flow into Adaptive.
* Conduct training, create job aids, and maintain documentation for processes and system changes.
* Lead cross\-functional sessions to gather business requirements and translate into systems configurations.
* Utilize SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) and APIs for seamless data exchange.
* Drive automation and process improvements across financial workflows.
* Monitor system performance and proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Manage user access and security policies to safeguard system integrity.
* Document system configurations and procedures for future reference and compliance.
* Provide user support and training to ensure effective system utilization.
* Lead system audits and compliance checks to meet regulatory requirements.
* Implement new SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ecosystem modules and features to enhance system capabilities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud systems with other business applications.
* Develop and execute system improvement plans to optimize performance and efficiency.
* Monitor all upcoming changes being deployed by SAP. Work on testing plans and keeping senior staff updated on upcoming changes.

* Execute UAT and tasks for Upgrades, Mergers and Acquisitions, Vendor Coordination, and other associated projects.
* Monitor and troubleshoot SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ecosystem integrations.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to address system issues effectively.

 As an External Data Services Manager at ICON, you will be instrumental in leading the development and implementation of advanced data science solutions for clinical trials.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 You will manage day\-to\-day clinical data science activities, supporting your team to deliver quality outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Lead the development of Data Transfer Specifications (DTS) documents to align external data providers and research partners on the required structure for new data. This includes:
* Authoring the DTS, responding to external data providers and internal stakeholder queries to ensure
* data will be delivered in the correct format and structure.
* Track DTS status with external data providers across different data types and programs and ensure data completion dates are met for study timelines and deliverables.
* Ensuring data structure based on the type(s) of data being used is consistent and compliant with appropriate data templates.
* Ensuring data structure is consistent across each data provider and comply with appropriate data templates.
* Support data reconciliation and data structure inquiry resolution.
* Liaise cross functionally to facilitate the creation of new test codes.
* Participate in the Clinical Study Team as an extended team member.
* Oversee and train in the use of the DTS and other supplemental documents.
* Contribute to improvement initiatives as it relates to external data process.
* Ensure study teams adhere to CDISC standards as it relates to external data.
* Comply with all pertinent regulatory agency requirements (Understand clinical protocols and requirement for Biomarkers/Imaging/eCOA data, blinding and analysis expectations).
* Process change requests to update existing DTS.
* Improve templates for existing DTS to ensure data harmonization and downstream analytics.
* Provide external data management oversight to vendors, providing a pathway for functional discussions, partnership level processes \& standards, portfolio status, communication, and escalation.
* Review and contribute to eCRF and EDC builds as it relates to external data requirements.


**Your Profile**
 You will have solid clinical data science experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications And Experience**
* Minimum 8\+ years of experience in external data services
* Expertise in biomarker data types and/or Imaging data for oncology and non\-oncology studies is preferred
* Experience working with multiple data types/formats
* Experience in managing clinical, biomarker data, eCOA and imaging data
* Demonstrates broad knowledge of all applicable regulations including 21 CFR
* Part 11, ICH\-GCP Guidelines and CDISC standards for data collections.
* Demonstrates advanced knowledge of Data Management processes and industry best practices.
* Advanced knowledge and experience with extracting data into SAS, CSV, and
* XML formats is required.
